WarMonitor RT @thesupermannx : Researchers discovered a new psychological condition caused by ChatGPT. They're calling it "Cognitive Surrender." Researchers ran three experiments across 1,372 people and 9,593 reasoning trials. They gave participants access to an AI assistant, but secretly rigged the AI to be accurate on some trials and subtly wrong on others. People consulted the AI on more than 50% of the trials. When the AI was right, human accuracy jumped by 25 percentage points. When the AI was wrong, accuracy crashed by 15 percentage points. Participants didn't double-check the output. They didn't catch the errors. They let System 3 override both their gut instinct and their critical thinking. Then came the darker finding. Using the AI made people measurably more confident in their answers—even when the AI fed them completely wrong information. The researchers tried to break the habit. They added time pressure. They gave participants live feedback and financial incentives to get the right answer. It didn't work. Even when money was on the line, people still surrendered their judgment to a faulty AI. We used to think AI was just a tool to help us think faster. It's not. It's quietly replacing the act of thinking altogether. tweet

OSINTdefender Russian Navy and military-linked cargo ship convoy spotted by SynMax Maritime off the coast of Tunisia in the Mediterranean Sea on Thursday, prior to being attacked last night and today while at the Port of Benghazi, Libya. On the 19th of November 2026, SynMax’s maritime domain awareness platform, Theia, detected a five-vessel Russian convoy in the Mediterranean Sea, off the coast of Tunisia. The group is made up of the sanctioned Russian-flagged cargo ships LADY D (IMO 9349289), MAIA-1 (IMO 9358010), and LADY R (IMO 9161003), the Project 160 fleet tanker YELNYA, and a Russian frigate assessed to be the Project 22350 ADMIRAL GOLOVKO. The three cargo ships departed Baltiysk, Kaliningrad, on the 5th of November and were escorted through the Danish straits by the Baltic Fleet corvette STOIKIY. By the 11th of November, they were exiting the western end of the English Channel, reportedly under French naval escort. On the 12th of November, AIS signals ceased to be received from the vessels. All three have long histories of transporting military cargo and are linked to MG-FLOT LLC, a sanctioned entity. It has been broadly reported that armored vehicles and logistics trucks were loaded onto the cargo ships at Baltiysk, although the cargo and destination have not been confirmed. Theia ingests more than 40 million km² of satellite imagery daily, fusing it with global AIS and additional intelligence sources to automatically detect, identify, and track tens of thousands of vessels, regardless of their AIS output. Extensive imagery archives allow analysts to establish patterns of life and maintain visual custody of vessels as they move through dark periods. SynMax’s Agentic AI, Atlas, interrogates these pre-processed, auditable datasets to highlight anomalous behavior for analysts, multiplying their capacity to deliver high-quality intelligence to decision-makers. - SynMax Maritime tweet

I realized the way the IDF was conducting the military operations there, trying to avoid casualties as much as they could with various measures, by sending messages: leave this neighborhood, we have to bomb here, change place. They did whatever they could in a very difficult field. But in the West, most people think that you just went there to murder children or to murder innocent people.
